title: Crossing the Border
content: So basically I dreamt about crossing a border through a road, and somehow the road turned into an aqueduct and I was on a extremely small boat. Somehow the aqueduct didn't have any water whatsoever. I traveled into a strange tunnel that helped me cross a border. At the other side of the dark tunnel, I turned out to encounter a pool and the aqueduct without water turned out to be a water slide all along. I barely woke up minutes ago, once I landed in the water. Thing is, I keep on having the strangest dreams. I know that my dreams aren't coming from inside me at all. As much as I desire escaping this matrix, the "dreamscape" keeps having a mind of its own. Yeah, I rarely have nightmares anymore. It's just me stumbling upon arriving at areas where people just accept me with open hands just for the dreams to end abruptly once I am being accepted in a group. Btw, by the end of the water slide, there were some kind-looking people who were so inviting in their territory. Now come to think of it, could it just be another "trap"? For the last 2 nights, I dreamt about encountering the kindest-looking people to me and then once I get involved with them my dreams a abruptly end. It's weird that I am having the nicest dreams ever, but at this point, I know that something's up. I know that I desire true freedom, but somehow my 2 dreams from last night carried the same type of destination.
